typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		BATCH_ID as string,
		INVOICE_FROM_DT as timestamp,
		INVOICE_TO_DT as timestamp,
		FACETS_BLEI_CK_COUNT as string,
		FACETS_INVOICE_COUNT as string,
		FACETS_BILLED_AMT as integer,
		FIS_BLEI_CK_COUNT as string,
		FIS_INVOICE_COUNT as string,
		FIS_BILLED_AMT as integer,
		VARIANCE_BILLED_AMT as integer,
		VARIANCE_BLEI_CK as string,
		VARIANCE_INVOICE as string,
		EX_ENTITY_COUNT as string,
		EX_INVOICE_COUNT as string,
		EX_BILLED_AMT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT 	t.BATCH_ID, 	t.INVOICE_FROM_DT, 	t.INVOICE_TO_DT, 	t.FACETS_BLEI_CK_COUNT, 	t.FACETS_INVOICE_COUNT, 	t.FACETS_BILLED_AMT, 	t.FIS_BLEI_CK_COUNT, 	t.FIS_INVOICE_COUNT, 	t.FIS_BILLED_AMT, 	t.VARIANCE_BILLED_AMT, 	t.VARIANCE_BLEI_CK, 	t.VARIANCE_INVOICE, 	t.EX_ENTITY_COUNT, 	t.EX_INVOICE_COUNT, 	t.EX_BILLED_AMT  FROM AGP.FIST_BAL_SUMMARY t',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBREADSUMMARYTABLE
SRCOLEDBREADSUMMARYTABLE derive(DC_EX_BILLED_AMT = toDecimal(EX_BILLED_AMT,19,19),
		DC_FIS_BILLED_AMT = toDecimal(FIS_BILLED_AMT,19,19),
		DC_FACETS_BILLED_AMT = toDecimal(FACETS_BILLED_AMT,19,19),
		DC_VARIANCE_BILLED_AMT = toDecimal(VARIANCE_BILLED_AMT,19,19)) ~> DCSUMMARYFIELDS
DCSUMMARYFIELDS sink(input(
		{} as decimal(0,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> DESTXLSSUMMARYREPORT
SRTDETAILEDFIELDS sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> DESTXLSDETAILEDREPORT
